retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast duotone portrait overlaid on a background of vibrant, multi-colored horizontal stripes with heavy, rounded display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central high-contrast duotone figure in a thoughtful pose, set against a background of alternating pink and orange horizontal stripes framed by blue blocks, featuring bold, arched display lettering at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject silhouette overlaps the striped background and bottom blue field
Arched title text follows a convex curve across the top header
Left-aligned tracklist text is centered vertically within the striped zone
High-contrast duotone skin tones match the background pink
coreInvariants: Horizontal color banding in the middle third of the composition
High-contrast black-and-color duotone treatment for the human subject
Heavyweight rounded serif typography for the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait positioned slightly right of center, extending from the bottom edge to the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast black silhouette of the subject's suit and hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the arched title, move down the left-aligned list, and settle on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid blue blocks at the top and bottom provide breathing room for the dense central patterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan blue in the header and footer blocks.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for the subject's shadows and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pink and orange for the horizontal stripes and skin highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value contrast between the black ink and the bright neon-adjacent background colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold rounded serif with high contrast
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with tight counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly kerned lowercase with large x-heights
Arched baseline for the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face paired with a smaller, high-contrast slab serif for secondary lists.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the iconic rounded, heavy-weight 1960s aesthetic.
Provides the necessary high contrast and thick serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a background with a cyan blue top and bottom block. In the center, create alternating horizontal stripes of vibrant pink and orange. Place a high-contrast duotone portrait of a man in a suit, using black for shadows and pink for highlights, overlapping the stripes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a white, heavy rounded serif font like Cooper Black, following a convex arch at the top. Add a list of text on the left side in black slab-serif typography.

verificationChecks: Are the stripes horizontal and alternating pink/orange?
Is the portrait a duotone using the background pink?
Is the font weight sufficiently heavy and rounded?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital gradients; use flat color bands
Ensure the subject is high-contrast duotone, not a full-color photo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure cyan header/footer blocks are present
recipe.reuseFormula: Duotone Portrait + Arched Heavy Serif + Horizontal Color Bands + Cyan Framing
